_about: Choices the onboarding wizard offers, so nobody starts from a blank page. Each choice becomes one plain line in preferences.md. 'sites' limits a choice to some sites (omit = every site). Written by Mission Control from what made a real Wingman judge well; no real person's preferences.

me.question: Who are you, in a few words?
me.hint: This tells the Wingman who it is picking for. Example: a man in my thirties, a woman in her twenties, a nonbinary person, a trans woman.
examples: a nonbinary person in my forties
a trans man in my twenties

looking_for.question: Who are you looking for?

choices.label: Women
choices.line: women

choices.label: Men
choices.line: men

choices.label: Nonbinary people
choices.line: nonbinary people

choices.label: Anyone who fits
choices.line: anyone who fits, whatever their gender

looking_for.free_text: Something more specific (for example: women and nonbinary people, or men who are into men)

where.question: Where should they live?

choices.label: My country
choices.line: my country

choices.label: My part of the world
choices.line: my part of the world (for example Europe, or North America)

choices.label: Within a few hours of my time zone
choices.line: a time zone at most three hours from mine

choices.label: Anywhere
choices.line: anywhere; distance matters less than fit

where.free_text: Name places (for example: Germany, Austria, Switzerland, the Netherlands)

green_flags.question: What makes you look twice? Tick what fits; add your own.

choices.label: Uses their voice
choices.line: - Someone who talks with their voice, not only in text.

choices.label: Full-body tracking
choices.line: - Someone with full-body tracking.

choices.label: Plays VRChat
choices.line: - Someone who plays VRChat.

choices.label: Same humour
choices.line: - Someone whose bio makes me smile; a sense of humour like mine.

choices.label: Playful
choices.line: - Someone playful, who likes to tease and be teased.

choices.label: Kind
choices.line: - Someone who sounds kind to other people, not only to me.

choices.label: Online often
choices.line: - Someone who is online most evenings.

choices.label: Shared interests
choices.line: - Someone who shares at least one of my interests: {free}.

deal_breakers.question: What is a clear no? Tick what fits; add your own.

choices.label: Heavy drinking
choices.line: - A heavy drinker, or someone who is always in drinking worlds or at parties.

choices.label: Smoking
choices.line: - A smoker.

choices.label: Never speaks
choices.line: - Someone who never uses their voice (a mute player). Text-only gets old fast.

choices.label: Possessive or jealous
choices.line: - Someone who sounds possessive or very jealous. A small red flag nearby, a big one far away.

choices.label: Only wants friends
choices.line: - Someone who writes that they only want friends.

choices.label: Too far away
choices.line: - Someone so far away that we would never be online at the same time.

choices.label: Drama
choices.line: - A profile full of complaints about exes or about other people.

choices.label: Empty profile
choices.line: - A profile with nothing in it but pictures.

choices.label: Not who they say
choices.line: - Someone whose profile does not match the gender or age they ticked. Weigh it; do not decide on one detail.

tone.question: How do your messages sound?

choices.label: Warm and playful
choices.line: Short, warm and playful, a little teasing, confident without being pushy. Simple words.

choices.label: Calm and sincere
choices.line: Calm and sincere. Friendly questions, no pressure, no pickup lines.

choices.label: Witty and dry
choices.line: Witty, with dry humour. Short lines, a clever callback to something in their profile.

choices.label: Short and direct
choices.line: Short and direct. One line, one question, no small talk.

tone.free_text: Paste one message you sent and liked (optional). The Wingman copies how it sounds.

language.question: Which language?
language.default_line: English, unless they write in another language I speak.

practice_examples._about: Shown on the training screen: what a useful practice answer looks like.

good.why: The Wingman got it right. Nothing more needed.
A reason teaches more than a no.

good.say: disagree, too far away, eight hours difference
good.why: Names the one thing that decided it.

good.say: like them, the bio is funny and we both build worlds
good.why: A like with a reason is a lesson too.
A one-off: the like or pass happens, the Wingman does not learn from it.

less_useful.why: The Wingman learns that you passed, but not why.
Not an answer yet. Say agree or disagree, then why.
